name: npn-op
deck:
BJT resistor temperature coefficients #1514, original MIT fixture
VC vc 0 5
VB vb 0 0.8
RLOAD vc c 100
RBIAS vb b 1k
Q1 c b 0 QM 
.model QM NPN TNOM=25 IS=1e-14 BF=150 VAF=60 IKF=0.01 RE=10 RC=30
+ TRE1=0.001 TRE2=1e-6 TRC1=-0.002 TRC2=2e-6
+ TRB1=0.003 TRB2=3e-6 TRM1=-0.001 TRM2=4e-6 RB=500 RBM=50 IRB=0.2m
.options temp=85 reltol=1e-8 abstol=1e-14 vntol=1e-10
.op
.end

name: pnp-sweep
deck:
BJT resistor temperature coefficients #1514, original MIT fixture
VC vc 0 -5
VB vb 0 -0.8
RLOAD vc c 100
RBIAS vb b 1k
Q1 c b 0 QM 2 M=3
.model QM PNP TNOM=25 IS=1e-14 BF=150 VAF=60 IKF=0.01 RE=10 RC=30
+ TRE1=0.001 TRE2=1e-6 TRC1=-0.002 TRC2=2e-6
+ TRB1=0.003 TRB2=3e-6 TRM1=-0.001 TRM2=4e-6 RB=500 RBM=50 IRB=0.2m
.options temp=85 reltol=1e-8 abstol=1e-14 vntol=1e-10
.dc temp -15 105 20
.end
